title: Baby in Vintage Walker Toy, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot dated July 31, 1949, capturing a cute baby seated in a vintage metal-frame baby walker/stroller toy outside on a grassy lawn. In the background stands a Victorian-style house with a white front porch and lattice trim, set against large shade trees. This photo offers a glimpse into post-World War II American family life and mid-century nursery items.
